question: Which power-united presence is asked to always protect the wife?
premises: The mantra syllables hūṃ and svāhā are uttered.
A presence united with power is invoked.
Continual protection is sought for the wife.
inference: The power-united presence is asked to always protect the wife.
plain_english: hūṃ svāhā — may the one united with power always protect my wife.
